title: A place for your thoughts
body:
# Welcome to Phosphor.

A quieter corner of your computer. For the ideas that arrive unannounced, the things worth remembering, and the projects still taking shape.

No feeds. No noise. Just you and the cursor.

## Make yourself at home

- Create a note with **Ctrl + N**
- Find anything with **Ctrl + K**
- Switch to the rendered view with **Ctrl + Shift + P**
- Write a little. Everything saves on this device.

## A small promise

Your words stay yours. Phosphor works locally, so you can keep thinking even when the internet takes a break.

> The act of writing is the act of discovering what you believe.

---

Try changing this note. This is your space now.
